annotations.title: SEC X-17A-5, 13F-HR & FINRA SRO Broker-Dealer Forensics

description: Synthesizes structured broker-dealer counterparty and prime-clearing forensics combining SEC Form X-17A-5 (FOCUS Report) balance sheet and Rule 15c3-1 net capital cushion multiples, SEC Form 13F-HR institutional equity/option book telemetry, FINRA BrokerCheck SRO enforcement dockets, and SHA-256 OFAC sanctions Merkle attestations by CIK, FINRA CRD, or entity name. Use when: auditing a registered broker-dealer, quantitative market maker, or clearing counterparty (e.g., HRT Financial LP CIK 0001475597 / CRD 152144, HRT Execution Services LLC CIK 0001263128 / CRD 128491, or any SEC-filing broker-dealer CIK) for Rule 15c3-1 excess net capital, repo leverage, 13F concentration, or SRO regulatory history. Do not use when: screening a non-broker-dealer entity solely against OFAC SDN sanctions (use screen_ofac_entity instead) or computing corporate issuer Beneish M-Score whistleblower bounties (use generate_sec_tcr_bounty_dossier instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic forensic synthesis ($2.50 USD per call via HTTP header x-api-key or x-payment-token; returns an x402/MPP paymentChallenge without charging if credentials are omitted).

cik.description: 10-digit SEC Central Index Key (CIK) of the registered broker-dealer or institutional investment manager (e.g., "0001475597" for HRT Financial LP or "0001263128" for HRT Execution Services LLC).

crd.description: Optional FINRA BrokerCheck Central Registration Depository (CRD) number (e.g., "152144" or "128491").

entity_name.description: Optional legal or common name of the broker-dealer firm used when CIK or CRD is omitted (e.g., "Hudson River Trading", "HRT Financial LP").

include_sro_dockets.description: Whether to include itemized FINRA and exchange SRO AWC/consent enforcement dockets (default: true).

top_holdings_limit.description: Maximum number of ranked SEC Form 13F-HR holdings to return between 1 and 50 (default: 10).

name: audit_broker_dealer_forensics

entity_profile.description: Resolved broker-dealer CIK, CRD, LEI, auditor, credit ratings, and prime brokers.

finra_sro_enforcement_matrix.description: FINRA BrokerCheck SRO disclosure summary and itemized enforcement dockets.

focus_x17a5_net_capital_forensics.description: SEC Form X-17A-5 balance sheet, repo leverage, and Rule 15c3-1 net capital cushion.

form_13f_institutional_telemetry.description: SEC Form 13F-HR equity, put, and call book summary plus ranked holdings.

ofac_sanctions_attestation.description: OFAC SDN screening status and SHA-256 Merkle proof.

receipt.description: Cryptographic payment or API key settlement receipt ID.

title: SEC Form X-17A-5 Net Capital, 13F-HR & FINRA SRO Broker-Dealer Forensics
